# Research Checklist — Secomm Launchpad

> Research checklist cho task hiện tại. Đánh dấu từng item. Khi tất cả stop-condition ✓ → research complete.
> Research entries ghi vào `project-context/memory/RESEARCH_NOTES.md`.

## Research trigger
- [ ] Research trigger assessed (mandatory / bypass)
- [ ] If bypass: reason noted ({typo / UI text / config / formatting}) — ghi vào RESEARCH_NOTES

## Cache check (trước khi research mới)
- [ ] `project-context/memory/RESEARCH_NOTES.md` checked — area đã research chưa?
- [ ] `project-context/memory/DECISIONS.md` checked — decision đã có chưa?
- [ ] `project-context/memory/LESSONS_LEARNED.md` checked — pattern/gotcha đã biết?
- [ ] If cached + unchanged → reuse (note "cached: {source}")

## Level 1 — Project memory
- [ ] Blueprint read (`toolkit/PROJECT_AI_BLUEPRINT.md`)
- [ ] `project-context/01–09` relevant files read
- [ ] Spec/ticket read
- [ ] `06_KNOWN_CONSTRAINTS_AND_RISKS` read (high-risk areas)

## Level 2 — Current implementation (Magento + Hyvä)
- [ ] Existing code/module inspected (không guess): `app/code/Secomm/`, `app/code/Mageplaza/`, `app/code/Secomm/`
- [ ] `di.xml` / `events.xml` / `module.xml` inspected (plugin chain, preference, observer)
- [ ] Hyvä child theme inspected: `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad/` (Tailwind source, Alpine, layout XML)
- [ ] Similar module/pattern found → ghi vào `similar-code-analysis.md`

## Level 3 — Internal docs
- [ ] Architecture doc read (`project-context/03`)
- [ ] API contract read (`project-context/05`) — đặc biệt GraphQL cho AddressDropdown
- [ ] Business rules read (`project-context/02`) — BR-001..BR-006

## Level 4 — External `[EXTERNAL: verify]`
- [ ] Vendor doc consulted (if needed) — version + date noted → `vendor-doc-checklist.md`
- [ ] Release notes / migration guide (if version-specific)
- [ ] Community (★★☆☆☆ — không override convention)

## Stop condition (8 conditions)
- [ ] Existing implementation understood
- [ ] Architecture impact identified
- [ ] Business rule impact identified
- [ ] Technology impact identified
- [ ] Unknowns listed `[UNKNOWN]`
- [ ] Implementation strategy prepared
- [ ] Risks identified
- [ ] Evidence recorded (entry trong `RESEARCH_NOTES.md`)

## Output
- [ ] `project-context/memory/RESEARCH_NOTES.md` entry written (Summary → Findings → Risks → Unknowns → Strategy → Evidence → Next Action)
- [ ] All findings classified `[VERIFIED]` / `[ASSUMPTION]` / `[EXTERNAL: verify]` / `[UNKNOWN]`

## Escalation check (Tier 2 — SA review)
- [ ] Có động đến `Secomm_VNPAY` (payment/IPN/signature)? → escalate SA
- [ ] Có động đến Mageplaza OSC checkout flow? → end-to-end checkout QC bắt buộc
- [ ] Có động đến address (AddressDropdown / VietNamAddress)? → verify hierarchical dropdown end-to-end
- [ ] Có DB schema change? → escalate SA
